easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Scurry Oak has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Tainted Observer and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature that shares a creature type with the creature that entered the battlefield.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
